candidates.title: Oral drug A versus placebo in adults with condition X: a randomised controlled trial
candidates.abstract: We randomly assigned 240 adults aged 18 years or older with condition X to oral drug A or placebo. Mortality at 30 days was the primary outcome. Drug A reduced mortality (p < .05) with a difference of ≥5 percentage points.

candidates.title: Oral drug A in adults with condition X: a retrospective cohort study
candidates.abstract: This retrospective cohort study reviewed records of 180 adults aged 18 years or older with condition X who received oral drug A. There was no randomisation and no placebo group.

candidates.title: Surgical repair of unrelated condition Y in children: a randomised trial
candidates.abstract: Children aged 2 to 11 years with condition Y were randomly assigned to surgical repair or watchful waiting. Condition X and drug A were not studied.
